newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to down 0.50 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to down 0.50 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open flat to down 0.50 cent Wednesday as LME eased from the highs following long liquidation overnight.
COMEX touched a five-month high Tuesday following a further dip in LME stocks to a fresh six-year low.
COMEX stocks Tuesday rose 745 short tons to 31,900 short tons.
On ACCESS, December copper last traded at 97.75 cents a lb, off 0.20 cent from Tuesday's close.
October's U.S. producer prices are due at 0830 EST. A rise of 0.2 percent was forecast.
The Federal Open Market Committee meets in Washington.
